top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes the most mature and generative achievement on the slate: the linked analysis of collateral constraints, balance sheets, and financial amplification made credit conditions central to macroeconomic fluctuations and policy transmission. Its citation can remain appropriately narrow despite the real distinction between the collateral and financial-accelerator strands.
recusal_note: No connection to the proposed B027 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. Documented collaborations concern committee colleagues rather than shortlisted credited candidates.
